mapper.select: SELECT T_A.* , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.NAME_ENC, '', 0) AS NAME , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.TELEPHONE_NUMBER_ENC, '', 0) AS TELEPHONE_NUMBER , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.ADDRESS_ENC, '', 0) AS ADDRESS , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.ADDRESS_DETAIL_ENC, '', 0) AS ADDRESS_DETAIL FROM ( SELECT SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID , SELLER_ID , ADDRESS_NAME , NAME AS NAME_ENC , TELEPHONE_NUMBER AS TELEPHONE_NUMBER_ENC , ZIPCODE , ADDRESS AS ADDRESS_ENC , ADDRESS_DETAIL AS ADDRESS_DETAIL_ENC , DEFAULT_ADDRESS_FLAG , CREATED_DATE FROM OP_SHIPMENT_RETURN WHERE SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID = #{value} ) T_A
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_SHIPMENT_RETURN (SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID, SELLER_ID, ADDRESS_NAME, NAME, TELEPHONE_NUMBER, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, DEFAULT_ADDRESS_FLAG, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{shipmentReturnId}, #{sellerId}, #{addressName}, #{name}, CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{telephoneNumber}, ''), #{zipcode}, CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{address}, ''), CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{addressDetail}, ''), #{defaultAddressFlag}, )
mapper.update: UPDATE OP_SHIPMENT_RETURN SET ADDRESS_NAME = #{addressName}, NAME = #{name}, TELEPHONE_NUMBER = CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{telephoneNumber}, ''), ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, ADDRESS = CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{address}, ''), ADDRESS_DETAIL = CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{addressDetail}, ''), DEFAULT_ADDRESS_FLAG = #{defaultAddressFlag} WHERE SHIPMENT_RETURN_ID = #{shipmentReturnId}
